passages.title: The Final Question
text: Now, here comes the final question.
Which country has the most pyramids in the world?
Hey Joe, tell us more about it.
Sudan and Egypt are close to each other.
Egypt is more famous for its pyramids, but Sudan has more pyramids than Egypt.
koreanText: 세계에서 어느 나라에 피라미드가 가장 많이 있을까요?
이봐요 Joe, 그것에 대해 좀 더 말해 주세요.
이집트가 피라미드로 더 유명하지만, 수단에는 이집트보다 더 많은 피라미드가 있어요.
